 GloryBound codes for November 2026
 How to redeem GloryBound codes in Roblox.
 Image credit: SphereX Studio 
 Guide
 by Dion Dassanayake 
 Contributing Guides Writer
Published on Nov. 9, 2026, 3:34 p.m. 
 Follow GloryBound
Prioritise us on Google 
 GloryBound codes will help you claim free Spins, which you can use to unlock new Blessings for your Roblox gladiator. The experience takes you back to the era of Ancient Rome, and turns you into a warrior like Maximus Decimus Meridius from Ridley Scott's classic movie Gladiator.
 In between fights you'll train your character like you would in incremental simulators, lifting weights so you become stronger. Then you have to head to the Colosseum, where you and a group of other players battle waves of increasingly more powerful enemies as you try to survive as long as possible. If you need a hand mastering the arena, you can use codes for GloryBound and get free Spins, which will let you unlock more powerful weapons (that in the game are known as Blessings). Codes are shared in the game's Discord server , but we've rounded up the latest codes below so you can just focus on becoming the most famous gladiator around!

 How to redeem codes in GloryBound
 When you start GloryBound, it's not immediately obvious how you redeem codes. If you're feeling a bit stuck, we're here to help. Below we'll explain everything you need to do to start redeeming codes and claiming free Spins:
 Launch GloryBound in Roblox .
 Complete the tutorial and finish your first fight. You won't be able to redeem codes without doing this.
 Once you've got through your first trip to the Colosseum, a button with a gift icon will appear in the top left of your screen. Select it. 
 Image credit: Eurogamer/SphereX Studio 
 In the menu that pops up choose the 'Codes' option. 
 Image credit: Eurogamer/SphereX Studio 
 Then type a code into the text box and select the 'Redeem' button. 
 Image credit: Eurogamer/SphereX Studio
